extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current patent and trademark practitioners; members of the public seeking practitioner or OED information
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes USPTO standards, procedural requirements, and OED-administered programs for who may practice patent and trademark matters before the USPTO, how to register, and where to find practitioners. Also points to disciplinary, pro bono, and clinic programs administered by OED.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered patent practitioner qualification
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered patent practitioners are individuals who have passed the USPTO's registration exam and met the qualifications to represent patent applicants before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED) administers the registration exam and maintains a roster of current patent practitioners. See 'Becoming a patent practitioner' for application requirements, forms, and exam information; refer to 'Registration exam update' for recent exam information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark practitioner qualification
rubrics_metrics.description: Trademark practitioners are attorneys who are active members in good standing of the bar of the highest court of any State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such attorneys are eligible to represent others in trademark matters before the USPTO. See 'Becoming a trademark practitioner' for more information about requirements to represent others in trademark matters before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics, grievance, and disciplinary oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: OED investigates grievances submitted against practitioners and provides public information about disciplinary actions against practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Current practitioners should follow applicable ethics rules; 'Information for current practitioners' contains ethics rules, common forms, and online access. Disciplinary actions and notices are published (e.g., OED Official Gazette notices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration application and notices requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals seeking registration to practice before the USPTO must follow registration procedures and are listed in 'Registration to practice notices' while seeking registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED publishes Federal Register notices and Official Gazette notices related to registration; applicants should review these notices and OED guidance when applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding and verifying eligible practitioners
rubrics_metrics.description: Members of the public can find registered patent agents and attorneys who are eligible to practice before the USPTO in patent matters and can find attorneys who practice trademark law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED maintains a roster of current patent practitioners and provides guidance/resources on locating registered practitioners; use OED resources and published notices to verify practitioner status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Pro Bono and Law School Clinic programs (OED-administered)
rubrics_metrics.description: OED coordinates a nationwide Patent Pro Bono Program for under-resourced inventors seeking free legal help and administers a Law School Clinic Certification Program where law students gain experience in intellectual property law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These programs provide avenues for representation and training; details on eligibility, participation, and administration are available through OED program pages and related notices.
